method.periods: Authoritative event season IDs plus verified format-specific ban regimes. Unknown season falls back to global; unverified bans use season-only bucket, explicitly flagged. Straddling events fall back to global.
method.model: Frozen quantity-aware card/player/matchup model plus online residual corrections. Champion residual means shrink toward zero; matchup residual means shrink toward champion difference / 2. Seasonal champion means shrink toward historical champion means; seasonal matchup means shrink toward the historical matchup correction plus the seasonal-minus-historical champion correction. Mirrors receive no correction.
method.updates: Both adaptive comparators start empty at the evaluation boundary and receive identical completed earlier-event outcomes. Outcomes enter only after recorded completion date, never same-day. Missing/invalid completion dates do not update. Base model and Elo remain frozen; no production publication-time timestamps are available.
method.selection: Prior masses 20/100/400 and symmetric calibration scales selected separately for global and seasonal candidates on the later 20% of original training dates, using inner-cutoff frozen model/Elo. No test outcomes choose parameters.
method.comparisons: cards = original raw model; adjustedContext = preserved calibrated card model (legacy scorer key); globalAdaptive = matched online comparator without periods; seasonal = official season + ban regimes.
method.uncertainty: 400 paired event-cluster resamples; exploratory, no multiplicity correction. Online state crosses events, so bootstrap does not capture all temporal dependence.
limitations: Retrospective sequential evaluation, not untouched future validation.
Ban coverage begins 2025-12-22 for Standard, 2026-04-03 for Pantheon; earlier periods explicitly unverified.
Current catalog; no reconstruction of historic card text or individual deck legality.
Seasonal adjustment corrects champion/matchup residuals; does not refit individual-card coefficients per season.
Unavailable completion timestamps exclude outcomes from adaptation; recorded completion is only a proxy for result availability.

familiarity.key: New list, up to 10% unseen copies
